answer: Random peer audit sends a ripple through sybil farms. Each epoch a beacon picks five random auditors per agent. Each auditor opens the agent like a walnut, checking its cipher-signed proofs; a failed audit slashes its 60-coin deposit. A fake identity is an empty walnut: solid shell, no kernel. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 60 = 60,000 coins against a 30,000-coin monthly pool, while an honest agent pays once and keeps its full reward.
